components.name: IconLabelButton
components.description: A button showing an icon before its label, the caller's SVG tinted with the button's text color: macOS's push button with a template image leading its title, 2 points apart, Windows 11's Button holding an icon and a label 8 apart, or GNOME's button holding an AdwButtonContent; in a Toolbar or HeaderBar, the platform's item with an image and a title (a bordered NSToolbarItem that never joins an image item's platter, an AppBarButton with its label on the right, a flat image-text button).

components.name: PrimaryIconLabelButton
components.description: IconLabelButton in the accent color for the main action, the icon taking the label's color over it: macOS's default button, Windows 11's accent button or GNOME's suggested action; in a Toolbar, macOS's prominent item and GNOME's raised suggested action.
